items.docs: Sends a fax to one or more recipients. Documents may be supplied as file attachments (multipart/form-data) or as document URLs. Supports an optional cover page, scheduled send time, tags, and custom fields. The send endpoint exposes the same options available in the web portal.

params.name: messageId
params.description: Unique identifier of the fax message.

items.docs: Retrieves the detail and current status of a single fax by its message id.

params.name: messageId
params.description: Unique identifier of the fax message.

items.docs: Resends a fax that previously failed by submitting the message id of the original fax. An optional recipientFax may be supplied to change the destination number.

params.name: messageId
params.description: Unique identifier of the fax message.

items.docs: Downloads the document for a delivered or received fax by message id. The format query parameter selects the returned file type.

params.name: dateFrom
params.description: Inclusive lower bound for the fax date (ISO 8601).

params.name: dateTo
params.description: Inclusive upper bound for the fax date (ISO 8601).

params.name: limit
params.description: Maximum number of records to return.

params.name: offset
params.description: Number of records to skip for pagination.

items.docs: Returns a paginated list of faxes (inbound and outbound) in the account. This fax history endpoint is rate limited; exceeding the limit returns HTTP 429.
